notes: Bay Area Reporter, 4 January 1990 to 26 December 1991, 104 weekly issues, read from the Internet Archive's DjVu text (no hOCR). Hand-curated: address clusters and event-word passages were read and each finding's quote checked against the issue. People rule as in the dossier: no owners, managers, staff, performers or patrons.

coverage.remaining: 1992 to 2005 remain: 709 issues in the collection, January 1992 to 28 July 2005.
coverage.note: 104 issues; 12,603 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets, 673 windows after the advertisement filter (386 of them rescued for an event word) in 607 address clusters, of which the 189 holding an event word outside the classified pages were read; plus 894 event-word passages, of which the 48 with a fire, closing, lost-lease or moving word and no out-of-town or review marker were read. 28 findings written, each quote found again in the issue's text; 3 take their number from another issue of the paper and one names a corner. 25 resolved and published on 25 pages, 3 of them seeded: 77 Battery Street, 150 Eureka Street (with its 4 unit pages) and 1340 Golden Gate Avenue, each taking up facts held for it (one from 1982-1983, two from 1980-1981, and the Redevelopment Agency's 1962 form, read again against its page image). 2180 Bryant is placed by hand on the parcel that carries 2170 and 2182. Two conflicts stated on their pages (Colossus at 1015 Folsom, 1990 against 1993; Josie's at 3583 16th, 1990 against 1988). 1 held (2193 Market, whose building the roll dates to 2002). 2 unresolved (4 Valencia, 890 Folsom). Two candidates declined before writing because their pages already carry them (1292 Page, 315 10th Street).
